headings: When and Where: Sat., Sept. 5 on the campus of Circleville High School located at 380 Clark Dr., Circleville, Ohio 43113 and accessible from SR 22 or Nicholas Drive.

Entries: Entries will be done on athletic.net. Search for Circleville Kiwanis Invitational. Make sure you do your entries as early as possible in case you have any technical issues. You need to register your team in our meet AND enter individual athletes into each race. There will be no runner additions on the day of the meet, so please ensure your roster is accurate before the entry deadline. However, we are charged by the number of entries, not actual runners, so if you know someone isn’t running, please leave them off your list. The entry window is open until Sept. 4 @ 9:30 am . Late fees may be charged for late entries. If you have problems, email me and I will try to help.

Entry Fee: $75/full team for each race or $15/individual. Maximum fee of $250 per school. Entry fees are based on entries, not actual participation. Send check to Jason Wells, Athletic Director, Circleville HS, 380 Clark Dr., Circleville, OH 43113.

Scoring/Results: Scoring/timing will be done by TriStateRacer. Results will be posted on www.tristateracer.com and Milesplit. We will be using disposable chips. This will allow runners to leave the finish area immediately after finishing the race, so we do not have any congestion in that area.

Course: The course is relatively flat with just a few small hills. It is both runner- and spectator-friendly, and has proven to be one of the fastest courses in the area. Course maps will be posted on athletic.net, and, as always, it will be well-marked on race day.
Awards: Team: Trophies to the top three teams in each race
